results.title: Parannoul Alter-Ego Huremic Shares New Record No Dancing Allowed
results.description: The anonymous, cult-beloved South Korean shoegaze auteur known as Parannoul has made a lot of music over the past few years, but he has been relatively quiet in 2026 — nothing since the one-off track " 연말 다짐 (New Year’s Resolutions) " in early January. But the same artist also makes music under the alter-egos Huremic and Mydreamfever, and now he's got a new Huremic record out in the world, following last year's Seeking Darkness and the compilation track " 3 ." The post Parannoul Alter-Ego Huremic Shares New Record No Dancing Allowed appeared first on Stereogum .

results.title: Charlie Kirk's Family Reacts After Judge Sends Tyler Robinson Case to Trial
results.description: A Utah judge determined that conservative activist Charlie Kirk’s alleged killer, Tyler Robinson, will stand trial for murder and associated charges. Robinson, 23, appeared in court in Provo, Utah, on Tuesday, September 1, for the conclusion of his preliminary hearing.
